status: Proposed explicit custom mechanical and electrical acceptance contract for PCB integration; supplier feasibility and prototype qualification remain open
custom_part_name: Velluneo T1 EE10 180T AWG32 1mH 3-terminal laboratory prototype

mechanical_basis.bobbin: TDK BE10-118CPSFR or supplier-made exact mechanical equivalent to this contract
mechanical_basis.matched_core: TDK PC40EE10/11-Z, controlled center-leg gap to final inductance
mechanical_basis.source: Manufacturer-authored TDK e140 July2003 catalog, native pages19/20/23/24; archived primary PI two-page bobbin extract and full catalog mirror
mechanical_basis.intermediate_pins: Not used in PCB. Archived source P1 varies2.5/2.6; retain only explicitly dimensioned outer terminal positions, do not derive outer span from three pitch intervals.
mechanical_basis.source_pin_numbers: Generic TDK bobbin drawing does not assign electrical terminal numbers; this custom part's labels are explicitly defined below, not asserted to be verified original EE1016 numbering

designed_mechanical_requirements.finished_envelope_basis: New design acceptance requirement around documented catalog envelope with tape/varnish/process reserve; not measured or supplier-confirmed finished maximum
designed_mechanical_requirements.PCB_coordinate_system: Top/component-side view looking down toward PCB; x right,y down; body origin centered. These labels form the custom winding/assembly contract.
designed_mechanical_requirements.bottom_view_convention: Mirror top view about x=0; preserves y-down convention. Mechanical drawing must state the view to avoid mistaken mirroring.
designed_mechanical_requirements.terminal_1_identification: Permanent visible dot/mark on component top adjacent to pin1 corner; mark must remain after varnish
designed_mechanical_requirements.supplier_fit_acceptance: Three-pin go/no-go gauge at contract coordinates plus12x12x13mm envelope gauge. No clipping or bending to force a supplied nonmatching bobbin into PCB. Supplier must approve feasibility before coil procurement.
designed_mechanical_requirements.terminal_position_tolerance_convention: Maximum RADIAL displacement of each terminal centre from nominal top-view coordinate<=0.15mm. This is a custom supplier acceptance requirement, not observed finished-part capability.

custom_winding_requirements.terminal4: No winding or internal electrical connection
custom_winding_requirements.insulation: One layer6.5mm winding tape and two layers4mm assembly tape per original reference intent; exact tape thickness, voltage and thermal class must be specified by coil maker
custom_winding_requirements.gapping: Set by final wound inductance measurement; not by an unverified nominal gap dimension
custom_winding_requirements.hot_DC_bias_requirement_status: Proposed root requirement; maximum winding temperature/test method must be set by electrical coordinator; not a sourced tested result
custom_winding_requirements.DCR: Proposed acceptance<=2.7ohm25C,<=3.6ohm100C; supplier and measurement required
custom_winding_requirements.thermal_core_loss: Unknown until material/coil build and switching waveform are confirmed. Catalog core loss at100kHz,200mT,100C is not this circuit's measured loss.

procurement_state.type: Custom coil RFQ/build path; no immediate-stock finished coil claimed

integration_notes: This is an explicit custom mechanical substitution retaining electrical logicalpins1/4/8. It does not certify the originalEE1016 geometry.
Root may capture a PCB candidate using this contract and must expose customcomponent procurement/buildability as an open requirement before purchase.
A finished PCBroute or rendered3Dmodel verifies only thatdeclared envelope, not actualunsourcedcoil fit.
Do not substituteE10/5/5 or arbitraryEE10core; matchedwindingwindow and magneticproperties differ.

historical_150T_winding_screen_supersede.screen_limit: Nominal geometry only. Wire outerdiameter, end packing, crossover, layer placement, tape, actualwindowminimum and tolerances must be confirmed.0.1mm axial margin is small and is not proof of supplier manufacturability.
historical_150T_winding_screen_supersede.flux_screen_limit: Using nominalAe; this is a warning for saturation review, not a guaranteed operating point or thermal qualification. Actualminimumcrosssection andhot materialB-H must be reviewed.

calculated_winding_screen_not_measuremen.limits: Nominal packing only. Gap/fringing, winding tape, actual minimum window and supplier manufacturing not confirmed. Fault saturation at maximum IC limit unresolved; no safe fault qualification.
